Dr. Lopez and her team are simply outstanding! I would not choose any other place for boarding or care, this team truly cares and goes above and beyond.

Thank you for caring for Dex and Cookie while we were away on vacation!

I took a friend's dog for a quick visit in order to get an allergy shot. Everyone was extremely cordial, well-mannered and the visit was very prompt.
Bravo!
I love everything about Metropaws! They truly care for my little fur baby and it’s always a wonderful experience going.

I have been a client of metro Paws for over 2 decades and started going to the new White Rock location when it opened! You guys are top notch! Best Drs, best vet techs, best prescription staff - just overall a wonderful group of people to help us love our furry children!
Stellar people and even better pet care. 11/10 would recommend all veterinarian services and pet medication be fulfilled by this magnificent team!
Great experience today.  Everyone is super nice and knowledgable.  We highly recommend.
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!
Loved it, staffing was super friendly and helpful
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!

I wish I could give everyone here gold stars! About 3 weeks ago our dog was scheduled to have mast cell tumors removed at our regular veterinary clinic. About an hour after dropping him off we received a call that during the preop they discovered a lesion on his spleen. He needed a splenectomy, but since he was a large dog they weren’t equipped to do the procedure there. They gave us referrals to a few surgery centers. We called around and most of them would only do the splenectomy or wanted to do it as separate surgeries. Our vet strongly recommended we have both surgeries done at once. On top of that the surgery centers were telling us we were looking at $7,000+ just for the splenectomy and they also had questionable reviews that left us feeling concerned. Thankfully, we started calling around and we were referred by another hospital to Metro Paws. They were able to get us in for a consult and surgery within a week! The reviews were wonderful and now that we are 10 days post surgery I can strongly recommend them as well. Everyone was wonderful! From the moment I called they were compassionate and genuinely kind. They answered all my questions and encouraged me to text with any questions I might have at any time. When I did have questions they were great about getting back to me in a very timely manner. I kind of wish my actual physicians office was this responsive. They were even better in person. So kind and we never felt rushed through any of our appointments. Our dog’s surgery was on a Friday and the veterinarian was checking on us all weekend. He’s healing up beautifully and well on his way to being in his silly self again. I am so grateful we were told about this office. I almost forgot to mention that they did both of his surgeries at once and for half the cost the surgery centers were quoting us.

I took my little boy there today after taking him to a different vet called Dallas Animal Urgent Care. The other vet sent labwork to Metro Paws. The other vet was claiming he had an allergic reaction to something and was trying to charge me a $1000 to just treat (what they think it is)

Minutes after I took him Metro Paws, the doctor came to to the room and showed me a 4.32 centimeter tumor that was pushing on his organs. There was no upselling, no recommended surgery, I could tell the doctor truly was concerned for my dogs health. I came to the understanding with my dogs age and the size of the tumor and the size of him, euthanization was the route to go.

They didnt rush me or anything and they were very comforting with me from the doctor to the front desk. I love my dog skip and will miss him forever but I wont ever forget the service I recieved here. Amazing, even with me on an emotional day with sadness and anger.

My terrier, Jack,  had to have ten teeth pulled. The team, especially Rhonda, was gentle and patient with my scared and aggressive boy.  The surgeon touched base with me during the procedure which I greatly appreciated.  The aftercare and meds were explained.  And I even got a call the next day to see how Jack was doing. Jack high as a kite on the way home.

Truly the best vet I’ve ever been to. Not one to usually leave reviews but I just love this place. Both Dr. Donaldson (now Roche!) and Dr. Sarpong are great. I have an elderly (grumpy) guy and they’re so good with him. Also appreciate how transparent they are with pricing!
Caring knowledgeable staff!

Everyone was so kind and knowledgeable during our urgent care visit for our bunny. They took great care of him and loved on him just as we would. Hated the circumstances but so blessed to have found Metro Paws, Dr. Alvarez, Katie, and the sweet girls up front ( im sorry i did not get your names) I was so scared and the kindness, compassion and knowledge you all showed made a world of difference. We will definitely be coming to you for all of our Duke's needs.

Dr. Alvarez and his team did a great job making my anxious dog feel comfortable during her visit. This place was also very reasonably priced compared to other places I’ve been to, and they even sent my dog home with a little toy and bandana! How sweet!

Amazing everything! The doctors, the availability, the price, even the decor in the rooms! Everyone is always so polite and gentle with my baby. They are super informative and recommended several options. My dog loves that there's fluffy grass to use right before going in and when coming out of her appointments. One time my dog had a 1-hr procedure so I said I would be in the car waiting. Well they brought my dog out in a blanket and even sent the front desk lady to charge me by my car window. VIP service! I love everything about this place. You will love this place, too!
My wife and I have been using Metro Paws for many years and love it. Their Doctors and staff are fantastic and we have recommended them to many of our friends over the years. Can't recommend enough
Amazing care from Lauren and Anna!

I brought my cat Apollo to Metro Paws WR for a cystotomy after being treated for a urinary blockage at a 24-hour emergency vet. Dr. Roche was so kind and thorough and was so helpful in explaining what would happen and answering my questions. Bri, the surgery tech, was incredibly kind and very gentle and loving with Apollo. It was clear to me from the beginning that they genuinely cared about him and wanted to help. When I picked him up the next day, Bri was also super helpful in showing me how to give Apollo his subcutaneous fluids. Dr. Roche prescribed several different meds to keep him as comfortable as possible and to set him up for success. She even gave me her personal phone number in case I had questions over the weekend. Unfortunately, Apollo passed away 2.5 days after his procedure due to an unknown complication from the surgery. Dr. Roche again was so kind and compassionate and made sure to speak with me on the phone to go over what happened and try to figure out why he passed. The office even sent us flowers. Apollo’s passing is a loss like no other; it truly feels like part of my soul died with him. It has been such a great comfort, though, to know his last days were spent with people who truly cared for him and wanted to help. I felt so taken care of throughout this whole experience. I never felt like I was in the situation alone; I always felt like we had support. This is one of the best vet offices I have ever been to; vets like Dr. Roche and techs like Bri are exactly who you want caring for your pets.

Dr. Roche is the best vet I've ever had!  She is thorough and goes the extra mile!  It's easy to see she loves her job and was meant to be a vet.  It's a blessing to have her as my sheltie Layla's vet! I highly recommend Metro Paws at White Rock!

Metro Paws 🐾 is the best!
I have been going there for over 17 years
Every location.
Dr.Adams Dr Roche Dr Lavender and all their Doctors
have a wealth of knowledge,
they’re compassionate their love for your pet is apparent they go over and above to make you and your pet feel comfortable cared for at all times.
There clinics are impeccably clean, and welcoming their staff is outstanding.

Dr.Adams and her entire staff were extraordinary during Scouts  time of need. they fought alongside us every step of the way with compassion, honesty, and unwavering dedication. making sure Scout was surrounded by care and  love, even though the outcome was not what we hoped for.
We always knew he was in the very best hands. we are forever grateful for the kindness and support and highly recommend
Metro Paws 🐾  to anyone who’s looking for exceptional care we are so thankful . Colleen, Christopher,  Dimitri Bandit and Shooter.!
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!

Metro Paws is the best! They truly care about your pet (Lucy Lou) and they care about you. I will never take them to another vetetinarian other than Metro Paws, the White Rock location. The staff member, Britney, at the front desk and the veterinarian Dr. Alvarez were both so awesome and kind. I just don't even know how to describe it. Just simply the best and I'm so grateful to them.

I just cannot thank the sweet girl, Britney, at the front desk enough.

I have had a tough 5 years, after my mom had a massive heart attack and 2 strokes on Christmas Day of 2020. This is the first time I actually feel good in 5 years.

A highly recommend anyone out there that's looking for a vet or even has a vet, check out the Metro Paws White Rock location They are the best!

Sherry A Moore

Who are these absolute Angels on earth? How lucky are we to have found such loving Doctors for our child (pup). We had a nightmare happen to one of our babies and Metro Paw came to the rescue!!! The way they guided my anxiety, broke down in detail how the procedure would go, the LOVE and compassion they showed... My jaw is still on the floor. They saved my babies life and I am forever grateful. Dr. Kathryn and Dr. Roche were MADE to be Vets 🙂. I simply can not rave enough about these angels. Welp, after yesterday Metro Paws is the only one who will take care of all our babies!!!! Thank you from the bottom of my wife and I's heart. You were truly a God Send.
Dr. Alvarez and his team took great care of my dog who is really difficult and nervous.  Really impressive work by the team.

I have been very impressed with the service at Metropaws. I recently had a very tough problem; my husband was attacked by a dog at White Rock Lake. I was able to track down the owner and luckily her veterinarian was at my own dog’s clinic- Metropaws. This is no big surprise; the entire neighborhood loves this clinic. The veterinarian was in a tough position but she was able to help me create a plan to help me and the problem dog. I will forever be a client!!

If you love your fur baby, bring them here. Everyone I interacted with was extremely kind and they were happy to help anytime we needed. I worked with both Dr. Roche and Dr. Alvarez they are very knowledgeable and gave us amazing care. I’m so grateful to have found this place and met these loving people🧡
Love everyone there! They take sure great care of the pets and the humans!! Karina is so conscientious and sweet with the dogs. She’s the best!

All staff from the frontend to the tech and doctor very friendly and approachable.  You can tell they all love animals. I loved how everything looked modern.  The prices seem similar to most of the prices in this area. Highly recommend.

It’s never easy seeing your pet in pain, but having a surgeon like Dr. Lavender made a world of difference. She took the time to explain the procedure and recovery. She eased my anxiety by keeping me updated when they started and finished, as well as being available to answer questions when I brought him home.
The surgery itself was a success, and thanks to Dr. Lavender’s skill, Benny is on the road to a full recovery.

If your pet ever needs orthopedic surgery or advanced care, I highly recommend Dr. Lavender.
We love Dr. Adams and the rest of the staff! No long wait, kind and friendly service, and excellent care.
If you're looking for a fantastic veterinary clinic this one is it... add on the great care that Dr. Adams provides... if I could give 10 stars I would!
Everyone was friendly and welcoming. It is very clear that they love what they do and who they do it for! If I could give them 10 stars, I would!
The best

My puppy went in for surgery on his elbow. They communicated with me constantly before and after surgery to let me know he was doing well even when I dropped him off. Staff is very kind as well. They also wrapped him so nice a clean his bandages never fell off in between check ups. Definitely recommend.
My shepherd woke up with a bad limp so we made a quick appointment and they treated us and him very well!
Just fyi, Dr Donaldson and the whole staff here rocks!
Super clean facilities, incredibly friendly team to help you and your pet, and excellent customer service. Love Metro Paws White Rock!
Wonderful staff. Wonderful vets

Metro Paws is awesome! The staff and doctors are compassionate, helpful, and friendly. Dr Roche and Jen have been absolutely amazing with me and my girl Phoenix. My girl had a broken leg, and I dont remember her name unfortunately, but the pro that wrapped her cast/splint has gone above and beyond by decorating her cast with the cutest designs- hearts, flowers, etc. And it helped raise my spirits during a very difficult time. I highly recommend this place for excellent vet care.

I’ve brought my dog here a few times and was originally told that I could return in six months for a follow-up oral Bordetella shot, which would be covered from the first visit. I made the effort to drive a good distance based on that assurance—only to now be told I’ll be charged for it. I don’t appreciate businesses that say one thing and then change it later. Very disappointing and not the kind of service that builds trust.
Brought my puppy in for an emergency they immediately took care of him , staff was kind and attentive and so was the Dr !! Definitely recommend!!

Love the environment and staff! Gladys was very friendly and informative and patience with shadow! & the doctor was recommending me different routes to take for shadow which I liked. I also brought my dog here to get emergency surgery & they were able to patch him up and save him forever grateful for there team!

This place is amazing! They got my baby in quick. They were all so sweet to him! 😭 He has had a terrible vet experience so he is terrified of the vet. I could hear them all give him a round of a plause for being a good boy getting his nails trimmed. I will never go to another vet now. Yeti loves you guys! Thank you so much 🩵 …

If you want your vet to love and care for your fur baby as much as you love and care for your fur baby, Metro Paws White Rock is where you need to be. From the beginning of your pets life and through the end, I can personally attest to the fact that you and your pet would be hard pressed to find better care, better bedside manner and a more thoughtful team. We are so grateful for the care that they have provided for our dogs.
They take great care of our cats when we board them.  They know them by name.  Always comforting when we are going out of town.
I truly love this place, the Vets and employees are amazing and care for your animals, they make every effort to get you scheduled asap.

18-year client here.  If you are looking for the very best - in professionalism, in expertise, in on-site capabilities and in genuine care, then you can stop looking - you have found it at Metro Paws.  They are not part of a 'chain' and they won't try to "sell" you on anything!
Erm going for years, love this place

Dr. Roche (nee Dr. Donaldson) is *amazing*.  She has an impeccable bedside manner, and she thoroughly examines my dog.  She's also extremely honest.  Thus, I have no question with following her advice and explicitly trusting her.  **This is extremely important, as many vets just want to upsell services.**  In contrast, Dr. Roche is basically the perfect vet, who evaluates things honestly and helps clients find the most cost-effective treatment for their pets.

I have had extremely limited interactions with Dr. Alvarez, but also really liked him as a vet.

The staff is also kind and helpful.

It's important to note that individual vets within a practice vary in quality. I have had experiences I didn't love with vets here. Thus, I can 11/10 recommend Dr. Roche--and Dr. Alvarez also seems great (based on extremely limited interactions)--but I can't really comment on other doctors here

We've been bringing our fur babies to MetroPaws for years, but only recently met Dr. Alvarez. He is a blessing. Our doggie is a rescue and super skittish, especially around men. But Dr. Alvarez has such a kind, gentle demeanor and calming energy that by the end of our visit, our doggie was literally eating out of his hand. Vet tech Rhonda was also kind and loving (and even used her artistic skills to craft a personalized doggie bag for his meds and some extra take-home treats). Finally, the ladies who run the front desk were friendly and helpful, and accepted a poop sample with a smile. :-) So grateful for all the folks here, and the way they put all of us at ease.

Great vets!  Very cat friendly - they understand cats and how to make them comfortable.  Our cats do very well here and it’s a huge relief to us. The staff are wonderful and very helpful.  Dr. Donaldson and Dr. Clark are fantastic and have really helped us improve our kitties health. Briana is especially good handling our kitties and they love her.  Highly recommend!
Jill — Thank you for the 5-star rating, we appreciate it!
Great Vet, super friendly!  Our dog loved them.
Great vet clinic. All of the staff are very friendly and knowledgeable. They have gone above and beyond on so many occasions I’ve lost count. Highest recommendation.
Friendly staff

From top to bottom, the team at Metro Paws - White Rock is just fantastic. The team up there is always kind, informative, and gentle in their care. They treat my pup with respect and love, and I rest assured that my little girl is in the best hands in the metroplex. Thank you Dr. Adams and everyone at MPAH!

Metro Paws has been amazing for my little boy. The staff is always kind, professional, and truly cares about the well-being of the animals they treat. Every visit has been a great experience, from routine check-ups to any concerns I’ve had. They take the time to answer all my questions and make sure Bear and Dede are comfortable. It’s clear that everyone here loves what they do, and I couldn’t ask for better care for my pets. Highly recommend Metro Paws!

This is by far the best animal hospital I have ever been to. Dr. Sarpong is absolutely outstanding. She is kind, patient, and willing to answer any and all questions. After my dog was in the ER overnight, the decision/game plan that was made for us, and his treatment was the best option. He is healthy and I cannot thank them enough for everything they did for us. I would recommend this animal hospital to my friends, family, and anyone.
The staff is amazing!
Great vets who really care about my elderly dog. I like being able to book an appointment online.
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!
We’ve seen Dr. Adams, Dr. Sarpong (🐶’s favorite), and Dr. Alvarez and all three have been wonderful. So happy to have found Metropaws White Rock. …
We are always thrilled to see happy clients! If there is anything else we can do for you, please reach out to us directly. See you soon!

Amazing experience as a first time client today. Dr. Alvarez was amazing! The staff were helpful, efficient, and friendly. The facility is clean and inviting. There was no wait time. I am super impressed and excited to have Metro Paws as my new vet.
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!

We love this place.

Dr. Iván Álvarez and all of the staff are amazing, and super professionals. They take good care of Dobby. I totally recommend this place and trust them 100%.

Front the moment I called to the moment I got home best experience ever! Karina was fabulous answering all my questions on the phone with kindness in her voice . Megan was extra kind when my kitty was scared and Katie reached out after to make sure he was doing great . The Dr also reached out the day after to make sure he was doing great after his vaccines n treatment when did . I’m very very pleased !!!! Best choice I made in all time :) Wish I found them sooner !
